messages:
violet (eng-sre): Postmortem INC-1977 live. Root cause summary: KV cache eviction spiral + autoscaler mis-evaluating load. We need tidy runbook edits + clear owners.

violet (eng-sre): Proposed owners/dates:
- KV triage block (owner: omar, due: 2025-08-05)
- Fast containment 'safe-mode' commands + tiny diag tool (owner: lucy, due: 2025-08-07)
- Explicit autoscaler-failure escalation ladder + contact rotations (owner: ben, due: 2025-08-04)
- Tag as recurring-pattern + schedule 30d trend review (owner: violet, due: 2025-08-20)

omar (eng-platform): I'll add the triage steps: hit ratio, eviction tail, per-prefix fullness and a one-click fallback toggle (dashboard + runbook link).

lucy (eng-runtime): Taking containment. Draft snippet for runbook (copy-paste friendly):

```
# safe-mode: reduce concurrency + set cache readonly
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/inference-api -- python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=30 | jq '.prefixes[] | {prefix, filled_ratio, last_evicted_at}'
```

lucy (eng-runtime): I'll attach example output lines in the PR so oncall can grep `filled_ratio` quickly.

ben (infra): For escalation ladder propose concrete timings: 0-5m -> @oncall-sre, 5-15m -> @platform-pager, 15-45m -> infra lead + exec. I'll add rotation links and a pager snippet to avoid ambiguity.

omar (eng-platform): Good call. I'll put the escalation snippet directly in the runbook header so it's visible on page load. Also adding the telemetry query for eviction spikes (Grafana) and a small curl probe to check prefix fullness.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook created by omar: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-1977-draft PR #712.

violet (eng-sre): Scheduling a 20m walkthrough for oncall + platform on 2025-08-06 13:00 UTC. Please add any blockers here.

lucy (eng-runtime): One note: avoid automatic model-fallback in the runbook; open Optimize ticket for that. Keep runbook focused on triage and containment.

omar (eng-platform): Agreed. PR will exclude model-fallback. Tagging @violet for recurring-pattern label so this appears in the monthly digest.

ben (infra): I'll gate merge on adding contact rotations and the Grafana query example.

violet (eng-sre): Thanks all. After walkthrough and PR merge, I'll close the loop and create a follow-up to confirm the 30d trend review is scheduled.
